mapper.select: SELECT id FROM sys_user WHERE status = 1 AND deleted_at = 0 AND id IN #{id}

SELECT DISTINCT u.id FROM sys_user u INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id AND ur.deleted_at = 0 INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.status = 1 AND r.deleted_at = 0 WHERE u.status = 1 AND u.deleted_at = 0 AND ur.role_id IN #{id}

SELECT DISTINCT u.id FROM sys_user u INNER JOIN sys_department d ON d.id = u.primary_department_id WHERE u.status = 1 AND u.deleted_at = 0 AND d.status = 1 AND d.deleted_at = 0 AND u.primary_department_id IN #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO system_notification ( user_id, title, content, target_path, business_type, business_id, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{targetPath}, #{businessType}, #{businessId}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, title, content, target_path, business_type, business_id, created_at FROM system_notification WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id > #{lastEventId} ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
